reason: This is the CD-5 walker's own test suite: proving the walker flags bare `// TODO` / `// biome-ignore` / `// @ts-expect-error` annotations requires naming those exact literals in test titles and rule-string assertions, so the per-line matcher fires on the assertions themselves. A test of the annotation rule cannot avoid writing the annotations. The deliberately-violating fixture files it exercises live under test-fixtures/, which is scope-excluded; this entry covers only the assertion strings in the test body.
